title: Orders in spring 2024
statementMd:
List orders placed from 2024-03-01 to 2024-05-31 inclusive.

Expected columns: `id`, `order_date`.

Tables: `customers`, `products`, `orders`, `order_items`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT id, order_date FROM orders WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2024-03-01' AND '2024-05-31';
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
